source: Shaped from Sentry's OpenAPI spec (getsentry/sentry-api-schema openapi-derefed.json at b1eac6b, 2026-10-16, read 2026-10-17), operation "Retrieve Seer Issue Fix State" (experimental) and its AutofixInProgress example: the root-cause step keeps the example's shape with an invented description; the solution step's shape (solution[].title) is not in the example and follows the step the example's run would produce next. Not live-proven: no Sentry account recorded this.

causes.description: `automation.RunRipgrep` in seer/automation/tools.py is called without its required `query` argument since commit `4ebb4f342e30` (see #4512, query q2); reported by dev@example.com.

root_cause_reproduction.code_snippet_and_analysis: The process begins with an HTTP request to the `autofix_start_endpoint`. This is the entry point for the autofix workflow.
root_cause_reproduction.title: Autofix process initiated via API endpoint.

solution.title: Pass the query argument in `run_ripgrep` callers in seer/automation/tools.py
